title: Drop It: Block Paradise!
description:
Gameplay Objective:• Get the Star safely to the Ground

• Click on other Blocks to remove them or interact with them

• Let Gravity and Physics do its work

• Success!

Versus Mode• Get your Star to the Ground to score a point

• Knock your opponents Star off to also score a point

• Obstruct your opponent by sending them your blocks

• Pure Chaos

• First to 10 Points Wins!

Level Editor & Online Levels:• Multiple Level Sizes and Visual Styles

• Various fun Game Mechanics (Hazards, Bombs, Moving Platforms, Portals & More)

• Make fun, creative and exciting levels

• Upload and Share your level with others online

• Play levels made by others!

Features:• 150 Arcade Levels to Challenge your Wits across 5 Unique Worlds!

• Versus Mode: Play against a Friend!

• 100 Extra Bonus Levels 

• Leaderboards

• Level Editor: Create and share your own unique levels with friends!

• Block Database: Play more levels online from around the world

• Special unlocks: Achievements, Music & Art

• Cross Play & Cloud Saves - Continue your game on any other device
description_short: Drop It: Block Paradise is all about using various physic game mechanics, like gravity, bouncy blocks, bombs and more to safely get the Stars to the ground floor to solve Physics-based Puzzle levels. Featuring 250+ Puzzle Levels, Chaotic Versus Mode, Level Editor & Online Levels await you!
